shell_commands:
git add src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
fix(orchestrator): call beforeSession inside try block to allow error handling

Move beforeSession from outside the try block to inside, so that when it throws:
- The error is caught by the catch handler and onError fires
- afterSession runs in the finally block
- The error propagates to the caller as expected

This ensures all lifecycle hooks behave consistently regardless of which phase fails.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)"
git add .lore/dod.md && git commit -m "docs: update dod.md - mark beforeSession move as complete" && git push origin HEAD 2>&1
